```{r}
#| label: setup

pacman::p_load("tidyverse", "lubridate", "janitor", "here", "glue", "ggthemes", "forcats", "gt", "reactable", "gtExtras", "gtsummary", "reactablefmtr", "writexl")
invisible(here::i_am("death-certificates/cod-icf-deaths-firstpass.qmd"))


```

```{r}
#| label: load-data

group_labels <- c (
  "RHA Deaths"       = "RHA",
  "Non-RHA, Non-Gov" = "Other private",
  "Gov"              = "Government"
)

level_labels <- c (
  "3" = "3 Focused review",
  "2" = "2 Vigilance",
  "1" = "1 Expected (chronic disease)",
  "0" = "0 Baseline (lifelong condition)"
)

deaths <-
  readRDS ( here ( "death-certificates/cod-deaths-coded.RDS")) |>
  mutate (
    # government deaths have no facility name; use the owner
    `Facility Name` = if_else ( df_source == "Gov", "North Carolina", `Facility Name`),
    group = factor ( group_labels[df_source], levels = group_labels),
    death_date = ymd ( str_sub ( death_id, 1, 8)),
    level = factor ( level_labels[as.character ( max_level)], levels = level_labels),
    age   = as.numeric ( ymd ( str_sub ( death_id, 1, 8)) - ymd ( str_sub ( death_id, -8))) / 365.25
  )

causes <-
  readRDS ( here ( "death-certificates/cod-causes-coded.RDS")) |>
  left_join ( select ( deaths, death_id, group), join_by ( death_id))

```

## Death overview

```{r}
#| label: overview-table

deaths |>
  group_by ( group) |>
  summarise (
    deaths     = n(),
    facilities = n_distinct ( `Facility Name`),
    median_age = median ( age),
    natural    = sum ( manner == "Natural"),
    accident   = sum ( manner == "Accident"),
    homicide   = sum ( manner == "Homicide"),
    other      = sum ( manner %in% c ( "Pending", "Could Not Be Determined")),
    autopsy    = sum ( autop == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    autopsy_pct = autopsy / deaths
  ) |>
  gt ( rowname_col = "group") |>
  fmt_number ( median_age, decimals = 0) |>
  fmt_percent ( autopsy_pct, decimals = 0) |>
  cols_merge ( c ( autopsy, autopsy_pct), pattern = "{1} ({2})") |>
  tab_spanner ( "Manner of death", c ( natural, accident, homicide, other)) |>
  cols_label (
    deaths = "Deaths", facilities = "Facilities", median_age = "Median age at death",
    natural = "Natural", accident = "Accident", homicide = "Homicide",
    other = "Pending or undetermined", autopsy = "Autopsy"
  ) |>
  tab_source_note ( "Autopsy status was not recorded for 7 deaths.")

```

## How serious were the causes listed?

Each death is placed at the highest level among all of the causes on its record. The levels flag records for a closer look; they are not findings of neglect.

- **3 Focused review:** commonly linked to lapses in supervision, feeding, hydration, skin care or safety (choking, falls, dehydration, bedsores)
- **2 Vigilance:** good monitoring and timely treatment often change the outcome (sepsis, pneumonia, seizures)
- **1 Expected:** chronic disease, cancer or end-of-life decline
- **0 Baseline:** only the person's lifelong disability is listed

```{r}
#| label: level-chart
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 3.2

level_colors <- c ( "#1f3a5f", "#4f78a8", "#93afd0", "#d3dfec") |> set_names ( level_labels)

level_shares <-
  deaths |>
  count ( group, level, .drop = FALSE) |>
  group_by ( group) |>
  mutate (
    pct = n / sum ( n),
    group_label = glue ( "{group}\n{sum(n)} deaths, median age {round(median(deaths$age[deaths$group == first(group)]))}")
  ) |>
  ungroup () |>
  mutate ( group_label = fct_rev ( fct_inorder ( group_label)))

ggplot ( level_shares, aes ( x = pct, y = group_label, fill = level, group = level)) +
  geom_col ( position = position_fill ( reverse = TRUE), width = 0.6, color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text (
    aes ( label = if_else ( pct >= 0.05, scales::percent ( pct, accuracy = 1), ""),
          color = level %in% level_labels[1:2]),
    position = position_fill ( vjust = 0.5, reverse = TRUE), size = 3.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual ( values = level_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual ( values = c ( `TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "#3e3f3a"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous ( labels = scales::percent, expand = c ( 0, 0)) +
  labs (
    title = "RHA deaths were the most likely to include a cause calling for focused review",
    subtitle = "Share of each group's deaths by the highest level among their listed causes",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal ( base_family = "Lato", base_size = 12) +
  theme (
    legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left",
    panel.grid = element_blank (),
    axis.text.y = element_text ( hjust = 0, color = "#3e3f3a"),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    # reactablefmtr also has a margin() function
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin ( 5, 15, 5, 5)
  ) +
  guides ( fill = guide_legend ( nrow = 1))

```

```{r}
#| label: level-table

deaths |>
  tabyl ( level, group) |>
  adorn_totals ( c ( "row", "col")) |>
  adorn_percentages ( "col") |>
  adorn_pct_formatting ( digits = 0) |>
  adorn_ns ( position = "front") |>
  gt ( rowname_col = "level") |>
  tab_style ( cell_text ( weight = "bold"), cells_body ( rows = level == "Total")) |>
  tab_style ( cell_text ( weight = "bold"), cells_stub ( rows = level == "Total")) |>
  tab_style ( cell_text ( weight = "bold"), cells_body ( columns = Total)) |>
  tab_header ( "Deaths by highest level, count (share of column)") |> 
  tab_source_note ( "Other data show that RHA reports serving residents with more severe disabilities")  

```

## Deaths calling for focused review

Every death with at least one level 3 cause. Search across all columns with the box at the top, filter within a column with the boxes under the headers, or click a header to sort. Click the arrow at the left of a row to see every cause listed on that death, from most to least serious. (A complete list is linked below)

```{r}
#| label: level-3-table

level_3_ids <- deaths |> filter ( max_level == 3) |> pull ( death_id)

review_areas <-
  causes |>
  filter ( sentinel_level == 3) |>
  group_by ( death_id) |>
  summarise ( review_areas = paste ( unique ( care_focus_area), collapse = "; "))

uc_labels <-
  readRDS ( here ( "death-certificates/cod_sentinel_coding.RDS")) |>
  select ( uc = code, uc_label = short_label)

level_3 <-
  deaths |>
  filter ( death_id %in% level_3_ids) |>
  left_join ( review_areas, join_by ( death_id)) |>
  left_join ( uc_labels, join_by ( uc)) |>
  select ( death_id, group, `Facility Name`, lname, death_date, age, manner, autop,
           top_labels, review_areas, uc_label) |>
  arrange ( desc ( death_date))

# every cause on each death, most serious first, for the expandable rows
level_3_causes <-
  causes |>
  filter ( death_id %in% level_3_ids) |>
  arrange ( death_id, desc ( sentinel_level)) |>
  select ( death_id, rac, short_label, sentinel_level, care_focus_area) |>
  split ( ~ death_id)

level_3_table <- reactable (
  select ( level_3, -death_id),
  theme = nytimes ( font_size = 13, header_font_size = 11, cell_padding = 6),
  class = "nyt-table",
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  wrap = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 25,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  defaultColDef = colDef ( headerVAlign = "bottom", vAlign = "top"),
  columns = list (
    group            = colDef ( name = "Group", minWidth = 100),
    `Facility Name`  = colDef ( name = "Facility", minWidth = 140),
    lname            = colDef ( name = "Last name", minWidth = 90),
    death_date       = colDef ( name = "Date of death", format = colFormat ( date = TRUE), minWidth = 90),
    age              = colDef ( name = "Age", format = colFormat ( digits = 0), minWidth = 55, align = "right", filterable = FALSE),
    manner           = colDef ( name = "Manner", minWidth = 80),
    autop            = colDef ( name = "Autopsy", minWidth = 70),
    top_labels       = colDef ( name = "Level 3 causes", minWidth = 180, style = list ( fontWeight = 600)),
    review_areas = colDef ( name = "Level 3 care areas", minWidth = 150),
    uc_label         = colDef ( name = "Official cause", minWidth = 140)
  ),
  details = function ( index) {
    level_3_causes[[level_3$death_id[index]]] |>
      select ( -death_id) |>
      reactable (
        theme = nytimes ( font_size = 12, header_font_size = 10, cell_padding = 4),
        fullWidth = FALSE,
        columns = list (
          rac             = colDef ( name = "Code", width = 70),
          short_label     = colDef ( name = "Cause", width = 260),
          sentinel_level  = colDef ( name = "Level", width = 60, align = "right"),
          care_focus_area = colDef ( name = "Care area", width = 200)
        )
      )
  }
)

# plain divs rather than add_title(), which makes h1/h2 tags that pick up the page's heading styles
htmltools::div (
  class = "nyt-wrap",
  htmltools::div ( class = "nyt-title", "Deaths with at least one cause calling for focused review"),
  htmltools::div ( class = "nyt-subtitle",
    glue ( "{nrow(level_3)} deaths in North Carolina ICFs, {year(min(deaths$death_date))} to {year(max(deaths$death_date))}")),
  level_3_table,
  htmltools::div ( class = "nyt-source", "Source: N.C. death certificate records; cause-of-death levels assigned by the project team.")
)

```

## Download the data

[Download the full spreadsheet (Excel)](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rnzBfH_HJdtZXzlkmqerwrVyiDNlp1q-/edit?usp=drive_link&ouid=109144084184131668758&rtpof=true&sd=true)

The workbook has four sheets:

- **Deaths:** every death in the original combined file, one row each, with the coding columns added at the right
- **Causes:** one row for each cause listed on each death, with its plain-language label, care area and level
- **Code lookup:** every cause code in the data with its definition, care area and level
- **About:** what the levels and flags mean

```{r}
#| label: save-excel
#| eval: false

about <- tribble (
  ~item, ~meaning,
  "Level 3 Focused review", "Commonly linked to lapses in supervision, feeding, hydration, skin care or safety (choking, falls, dehydration, bedsores)",
  "Level 2 Vigilance", "Good monitoring and timely treatment often change the outcome (sepsis, pneumonia, seizures)",
  "Level 1 Expected", "Chronic disease, cancer or end-of-life decline",
  "Level 0 Baseline", "The person's lifelong disability or a condition present from birth",
  "max_level", "Highest level among all causes listed on the death. Levels flag records for a closer look; they are not findings of neglect.",
  "uc", "Official (underlying) cause of death: the manual code when there is one, otherwise the ACME code",
  "flag_infection_swallow", "Sepsis or pneumonia along with a sign of swallowing risk",
  "flag_ill_defined_only", "Cardiac arrest, sudden cardiac death or unknown cause, with nothing else listed except lifelong conditions",
  "flag_seizure_sudden", "Epilepsy or seizures along with a sudden or ill-defined death",
  "flag_assault_sequela", "Lasting effects of an earlier assault (Y871); the injury may predate the ICF stay",
  "flag_disability_only", "Every cause listed is a lifelong condition or epilepsy",
  "flag_bowel_unexplained", "A blocked or stalled bowel with no other explanation listed",
  "flag_seizure_pneumonia", "Epilepsy or seizures along with pneumonia",
  "needs_review", "Any flag, on a death without a level 3 cause"
)

deaths_sheet <-
  readRDS ( here ( "death-certificates/cod-icf-combined-deaths.RDS")) |>
  mutate ( `Facility Name` = if_else ( df_source == "Gov", "North Carolina", `Facility Name`)) |>
  left_join (
    deaths |> select ( death_id, group, age, level, uc:needs_review, -any_of ( c ( "max_level"))),
    join_by ( death_id)
  ) |>
  left_join ( select ( deaths, death_id, max_level), join_by ( death_id))

causes_sheet <-
  causes |>
  select ( death_id, group, order, code = rac, short_label, sentinel_level, care_focus_area,
           description, plain_language_definition)

write_xlsx (
  list (
    Deaths        = deaths_sheet,
    Causes        = causes_sheet,
    `Code lookup` = readRDS ( here ( "death-certificates/cod_sentinel_coding.RDS")),
    About         = about
  ),
  here ( "death-certificates/icf-deaths-cause-coded.xlsx")
)

```
